en.headline: Woman in her 50s dies after suspected hit-and-run on Castle Peak Road in Hung Shui Kiu
en.dek: Police said a passer-by found the woman unconscious in a planter near Chung Uk Tsuen Light Rail Stop at about 11.14pm on Monday; a male driver was later arrested.
body: Police said a woman in her 50s died after being found unconscious in a planter in the middle of Castle Peak Road-Hung Shui Kiu section in Yuen Long on Monday night.
A passer-by reported the discovery at about 11.14pm near Chung Uk Tsuen Light Rail Stop. The woman was taken to Tuen Mun Hospital but was later pronounced dead.

Initial investigations suggested she had been struck by a private car. Police arrested a male driver on suspicion of dangerous driving causing death. The driver had also contacted police, saying he suspected he had hit a pedestrian.
A portable charger was left in roadside bushes on the Yuen Long-bound side, along with suspected vehicle debris. Police are investigating the case.

zh.headline: 洪水橋青山公路疑撞人後不顧而去 五十多歲女子死亡 男司機被捕
zh.dek: 警方表示，周一晚上約11時14分，途人在鐘屋村輕鐵站附近花槽發現女子昏迷，送院後不治；男司機其後被捕。
body: 警方表示，一名五十多歲女子周一晚在元朗洪水橋青山公路段路中花槽被發現昏迷，送院後證實死亡。
途人於晚上約11時14分報案，指在近鐘屋村輕鐵站位置發現女子。她被送往屯門醫院，其後不治。
初步調查顯示，女子懷疑被私家車撞倒。警方拘捕一名男司機，涉嫌危險駕駛導致他人死亡。據了解，司機亦曾致電警方，表示懷疑撞到行人。
現場元朗方向路旁灌木遺留便攜充電器及懷疑車輛碎片。警方正調查事件。
